---
title: Project render
_quarto:
  # The per-file smoke render has no project index, so `.qmd` links in
  # site chrome stay unresolved there; assert link resolution on a
  # whole-project render instead.
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - '#quarto-announcement .quarto-announcement-content a[href="other.html"]'
        - []
---

Link targets in the announcement content are project-root relative and
resolve to the page's output URL.
